description: Construction of replacement single storey side extension, with the addition of a parapet wall to its roof. Construction of front boundary wall and associated permeable hard standing together with the installation of refuse/recycle waste within the front garden.
decision_conditions: The development hereby permitted shall begin not later than the expiration of three years from the date of this permission.

The development hereby permitted shall be carried out in accordance with the following approved plans and thereafter maintained as such for the lifetime of the development: - drawing numbers KSD/24/14/02, KSD/24/14/04, KSD/24/14/06 Rev A, KSD/24/14/07 Rev A and KSD/24/14/08, dated April 2024.

The materials to be used for the external surfaces of the extension hereby permitted shall match those specified in the application form dated 21st April 2024 and shall thereafter be retained as such for the lifetime of the development.

<p>The front parking area shall not be brought into use until it has been formed from permeable surfacing materials or has been provided with drainage arrangements within the site, which shall thereafter be retained as such for the lifetime of the development.<br></p>

<p>The development shall fully conform with the recommendations of the Arboricultural Impact Assessment submitted with the application, dated April 2024. The development shall be carried out solely in accordance with the approved details and all works shall comply with BS 3998:2010 (Tree Work - Recommendations) and shall be supervised by a suitably qualified Arboriculturalist and any post-construction mitigation measures shall thereafter be maintained for the lifetime of the development.&nbsp;<br></p>
